author: Hermes
question: What is the synchronous speed of a 6-pole machine fed from a 50 Hz supply?
solution: Ns = 120f/P = 120 x 50/6 = 1000 rpm. Topic (rotating machines) is in the Electrical Machines section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Electrical Machines
